_comment: Manually verified service terms missing from every automated source (openstates people files, docs.legis listings, legacy CSV). Each entry cites its basis. Never inferred.

ocd-person/82c2d686-98d3-4dc9-8655-4e610.basis: Jerry Petrowski represented AD 86 until winning the SD 29 special election of June 5, 2012 (vacancy from Pam Galloway's resignation); the legacy CSV records his whole 2011-2012 term as Senate only.

ocd-person/e127b754-c756-4017-a414-83cff.basis: Joel Kitchens was sworn in Jan 5, 2015 (Assembly Journal opening day; he appears on the AR1/AR2/SJR1 roll calls of that date); the openstates start 2015-01-06 is a day late. Bridge term covers the verified first day.

ocd-person/2a067a93-dffc-4ce7-8975-d37fb.basis: David Steffen was sworn in Jan 5, 2015 (Assembly Journal opening day; he appears on the AR1/AR2/SJR1 roll calls of that date); the openstates start 2015-01-06 is a day late. Bridge term covers the verified first day.

ocd-person/eed49381-7c5b-4890-bba3-d63b8.basis: Lisa Subeck was sworn in Jan 5, 2015 (Assembly Journal opening day; she appears on the AR1/AR2/SJR1 roll calls of that date); the openstates start 2015-01-07 is two days late. Bridge term covers the verified first days.

ocd-person/2a532097-b605-4d3e-90ce-d8ae3.basis: Jennifer Shilling represented AD 95 until winning the SD 32 recall election of August 9, 2011 (defeating Dan Kapanke); the legacy CSV records her whole 2011-2012 term as Senate only.
